task_instruction: Create res://scenes/audio_demo.tscn with a MarginContainer root named "AudioDemo" that fills the screen, uses 20px margins on all sides, and attaches res://scripts/audio_demo.gd exporting sound_dir defaulting to res://assets. Add a CenterContainer with a GridContainer child set to two columns with 10px horizontal and vertical separation for dynamically added Buttons. Add a CanvasLayer with an HBoxContainer top bar containing a Label node named Label using the Poppins-Medium font at size 24. The Label text should be constantly updated to display "Available Streams: {num_available_streams} | Queue: {num_queud_streams}", using this string template. Implement audio_demo.gd so _ready() scans sound_dir for .wav/.ogg files, adds a Button for each with its text set to the filename, Poppins font override, and pressed connected to on_audio_button_pressed, which calls AudioManager.play() on the file path. Ensure _process() updates the count labels to reflect AudioManager.available.size() and AudioManager.queue.size().
